items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: I told Hank Jones that years later when he was at some festival. He got a good laugh out of it.

ctx.x: And I said oh I love the sound of that chord. I wanted to know what that chord was. So I ran down two flights of stairs to the piano and started — I wish I had a piano here to demonstrate because it was funny. No. No. No. No. So I’d run up two flights of stairs and put it on, a 78 you know — it was not a — no that was an LP a 10 inch. And so finally this went on for over two weeks, up and down. I’m going to find that mother you know. And so finally — oh no, I took a red pencil and when it hit on the LP the C7…
That is some paying of dues right there.
